description: TerminalSim provides a C++ server-side library for container-terminal and transport-network simulation. The provider is Project maintainers. Geographical and temporal coverage: TerminalSim models capacity, dwell and handling processes and is designed to work with CargoNetSim; it has no GUI of its own. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is GPL-3.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: CargoNetSim is a related client, not an existing catalogue parent; client and server should be cross-linked when both are added. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
